title: 14-year-old Montana boy uses Rodeo Lasso to save drowning man on camping trip
summary_full: A family camping trip in Montana turned into a dramatic rescue when 14-year-old Jory Thomas used his rodeo lasso skills to save a man from the fast-moving Yellowstone River. After a raft and paddleboard crashed into a bridge pillar, one person was swept downstream. Jory roped the man on his first attempt and pulled him safely to shore before emergency responders arrived.
